ranks: Marvel Super Heroes Commander (MSC, 2026-06-26): top 50% by EDHREC rank, its last 41; Marvel Super Heroes (MSH, 2026-06-26): its first 19; with rebound built (rule 702.88) and the rebound cards it unblocked (Ephemerate, Transpose, Quantum Misalignment and more)

blocked.name: Wakanda Forever!
blocked.why: look-and-choose can't put its battlefield pick onto the battlefield WITH an indestructible counter; a `then` add-counter lands after the card's entry is announced, so enters triggers wouldn't see it (put-onto-battlefield's withCounters adds them before the announce).

blocked.name: Silver Surfer, Cosmic Voyager
blocked.why: flicker's `tapped` returns everything tapped; 'If a land enters this way, it enters tapped' needs tapped-by-type on the batched end-step return, and splitting per target breaks the simultaneous exile/return.

blocked.name: Namor, Atlantean King
blocked.why: No attacks-trigger gate for 'a player who has more life than you' (defenderLife has only most / more-than-another-opponent), and no filter for 'creatures attacking that player'.

blocked.name: Hyperion, Supreme Hero
blocked.why: would-deal-damage has only full `prevent`; no 'prevent all but 1', and `to` can't say 'you or a Hero you control'.

blocked.name: Queen Mother Ramonda
blocked.why: cantAttackController is 'can't attack you or planeswalkers you control'; Ramonda's 'can't attack you' leaves your planeswalkers attackable.

blocked.name: Power Pack
blocked.why: 'exile target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard chosen at random' is a target picked at random as the trigger goes on the stack; choose-random-card picks at resolution and isn't targeted (respondable knowledge, fizzling differ).

blocked.name: Astonishing Spider-Man
blocked.why: No turn stat for cards you've discarded this turn (the draw count includes discards earlier in the turn, not just the hand discarded now).

blocked.name: Captain America, Liberator
blocked.why: 'for each Equipment attached to him' needs an amount counting Equipment attached to the source; countOf's attachedTo can't name the source, and equipmentAttached is only a NumCompare

blocked.name: Hawkeye, Avenging Archer
blocked.why: 'if Hawkeye dealt damage to it this turn': damagedThisTurnBy filters by type/subtype/controller only, never this source

blocked.name: Karolina Dean, Runaway
blocked.why: 'This mana can't be spent to cast spells from your hand': notSpell's castFrom can't match a card still in hand at payment time

blocked.name: Immortus, Master of Eternity
blocked.why: power-up's 'each player shuffles their hand and graveyard into their library' has no effect kind (the mana ability itself is authorable)

blocked.name: Mysterio's Mirage
blocked.why: 'if you discarded a card this turn' has no turn stat or condition

blocked.name: Vulture, Feathered Fiend
blocked.why: deals-damage-batch gives no reference to the creatures in the batch for 'put a +1/+1 counter on each of those creatures'

blocked.name: M'Baku, Jabari Chieftain
blocked.why: become-monarch takes no target, no 'if there is no monarch' condition, and no attacks trigger keyed to the defending player being the monarch

blocked.name: Hulk's Thunderclap
blocked.why: optional 'behold a Gamma creature' additional cost and its 'if this spell's additional cost was paid' aren't modeled

blocked.name: World at War
blocked.why: rebound is built now, but additional-combat can't be placed 'after the second main phase' (cast in upkeep via rebound or the first main) nor carry 'at the beginning of that combat, untap all creatures that attacked this turn'

blocked.name: Ojer Pakpatiq, Deepest Epoch
blocked.why: rebound is a printed card field only; nothing grants it to a spell on the stack from a cast trigger (the rest of the card looks authorable)

blocked.name: Captain America, Living Legend
blocked.why: 'if it's the first time that creature has become tapped this turn' — becomes-tapped has no per-object first-time-this-turn clause and nothing tracks taps per object

blocked.name: World War Hulk
blocked.why: chapter I 'the next red or green creature spell you cast this turn can be cast without paying its mana cost' — player-effect's castFromHandFree is every spell from hand, not the next one from any zone; II and III are authorable (modify-pt powerOf/toughnessOf doubling)

blocked.name: Thor, God of Thunder
blocked.why: 'exile target ... card from your graveyard. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card' — exile's mayCast is cast-only (an MDFC's land face can't be played) with only end-of-turn/while-exiled durations

blocked.name: Loki, God of Mischief
blocked.why: 'whenever a player or permanent becomes the target of an ability you control' — becomes-target watches permanents by their controller, has no abilities-only / targeter-is-you clause, and never fires for a player

blocked.name: Leader, Super-Genius
blocked.why: 'If a creature you control would connive, instead you draw a card, then that creature connives' — no replacement on the connive event
